mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a loosening of monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the markets and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS decreases by > 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to negative investor sentiment and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in retail sales (RSAFS) suggests strong consumer demand, which can boost corporate earnings and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where RSAFS increases significantly.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a contraction in supply, which can lead to negative investor sentiment and thus negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where INDPRO decreases by > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) is rising, it indicates a tightening monetary policy which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests a strengthening labor market, which can boost investor confidence and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by > 100k and UNRATE decreases by > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increases by > 100k and UNRATE decreases by > 0.2pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strong demand for new homes, which can boost related industries and lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of the instances where HOUST increases by > 10%.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) growth slows down and industrial production (INDPRO) decreases, it signals a weakening economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% YoY and INDPRO decreases by > 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 growth < 1% YoY and INDPRO decreases by > 1%.
